## 3. DESCRIPTION (Final Public Copy — Plain Text)
Rain falls steadily against the window as neon city lights blur into color.
Inside, the room stays warm.
A CRT monitor hums softly, lines of code scrolling in the glow.
This 3-hour LoFi + Synthwave mix is built for late-night focus — coding, studying, writing, or deep creative work when the world goes quiet. Soft rhythms, analog warmth, and rain-washed atmosphere create a steady flow state without distraction.
All music is royalty-free and safe for content creators.
Best for:
- Night coding and programming
- Focused study sessions
- Writing and creative work
- Calm late-night productivity
Aesthetic:
Rain-streaked glass • neon city glow • CRT terminal text • analog desk gear • warm interior lamp • quiet midnight focus
